notes.title: Slide to Solve
notes.content:
I’m excited to announce the release of my new game, [i]Slide to Solve[/i], the follow-up to my first game, [i]Unitied[/i]! Check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432310/Slide_to_Solve/

If you already have my first two games, this one should be free, I think!

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Oops!
notes.content:
We all make mistakes. 
Especially in this game. 
Especially if multiple balls collide.

Well, therefore I added an undo-last-step button. 
This button only works for the last move.
So if the balls didn't collide in the way you expected, then pressing this button might help you.
